-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constforkeys

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Fields struct { A, B, C int }
type Record struct { i int }
type Dict[T any] map[int]T
type List[T any] []T
type DictAlias[T any] = Dict[T]
type ListAlias[T any] = List[T]
type RecordOf[T any] struct { i T }
type RecordAlias[T any] = RecordOf[T]

func check(label string, ok bool) {
	if !ok {
		panic(label)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", label)
}

func main() {
	const for i, _ := range comptime.Fields[Fields]() {
		m := map[int]int{i: i + 10}
		mv, mok := m[i]
		check("map-key", len(m) == 1 && mok && mv == i + 10)
		a := [3]int{i: i + 10}
		s := []int{i: i + 10}
		compound := [3]int{i + 0: i + 10}
		reverse := []int{2 - i: i + 10}
		const for j, _ := range comptime.Fields[Fields]() {
			nested := [3]int{i + 0: j + 10}
			if nested[i] != j + 10 {
				panic("nested-outer-index")
			}
		}
		check("array-slice-index", a[i] == i + 10 && len(s) == i + 1 && s[i] == i + 10 && compound[i] == i + 10 && len(reverse) == 3 - i && reverse[2 - i] == i + 10)
		r := Record{i: i}
		check("struct-field-value", r.i == i)
		n := map[int][]Record{i: {{i: i}}}
		nv, nok := n[i]
		aa := [3][3]int{i: {i: i + 10}}
		ss := [][]int{i: {i: i + 10}}
		ps := []*Record{{i: i}}
		mm := map[int]map[int]int{i: {i: i + 10}}
		mi, miok := mm[i]
		miv, mivok := mi[i]
		check("nested-elided", len(n) == 1 && nok && len(nv) == 1 && nv[0].i == i && aa[i][i] == i + 10 && len(ss) == i + 1 && len(ss[i]) == i + 1 && ss[i][i] == i + 10 && ps[0].i == i && miok && mivok && miv == i + 10)
		d := Dict[int]{i: i + 10}
		l := List[int]{i: i + 10}
		g := RecordOf[int]{i: i}
		dv, dok := d[i]
		check("generic-defined", dok && dv == i + 10 && len(l) == i + 1 && l[i] == i + 10 && g.i == i)
		da := DictAlias[int]{i: i + 10}
		la := ListAlias[int]{i: i + 10}
		ga := RecordAlias[int]{i: i}
		dav, daok := da[i]
		check("generic-alias", daok && dav == i + 10 && len(la) == i + 1 && la[i] == i + 10 && ga.i == i)
	}
}

-- m/expected.txt --
ok map-key
ok array-slice-index
ok struct-field-value
ok nested-elided
ok generic-defined
ok generic-alias
ok map-key
ok array-slice-index
ok struct-field-value
ok nested-elided
ok generic-defined
ok generic-alias
ok map-key
ok array-slice-index
ok struct-field-value
ok nested-elided
ok generic-defined
ok generic-alias
